title: Avalanche Bulletin CAAMLv6 Collection
description: Comprehensive JSON schema for the European Avalanche Warning Services (EAWS) avalanche bulletin collection, following the CAAMLv6 standard. This schema defines the structure, required fields, and data types for encoding avalanche bulletins, supporting multilingual content, region-specific data, and detailed avalanche problem reporting.

bulletin.title: Avalanche Bulletin
bulletin.description: An avalanche bulletin containing all relevant information for a specific set of regions and a defined time period. Includes metadata, danger ratings, avalanche problems, weather information, and travel advisories. Each bulletin is uniquely identified and may be issued in multiple languages.

bulletinID.title: Bulletin ID
bulletinID.description: A globally unique identifier for the bulletin. Typically a string or UUID generated by the issuing authority.

lang.title: Language Code
lang.description: Language in which the bulletin is published, represented as a two-letter ISO 639-1 code (e.g., 'en' for English, 'de' for German).

publicationTime.title: Publication Time
publicationTime.description: The exact date and time when the bulletin was officially published by the Avalanche Warning Service (AWS). Format: ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g., '2025-01-15T07:30:00Z').

validTime.title: Valid Time
validTime.description: The time period during which the bulletin is valid. Includes both start and end times in ISO 8601 format, allowing users to determine the relevance of the information.

nextUpdate.title: Next Update
nextUpdate.description: Scheduled date and time for the next bulletin release, as planned by the AWS. Format: ISO 8601 timestamp.

unscheduled.title: Unscheduled
unscheduled.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this bulletin was issued outside the regular schedule (true = unscheduled, false = scheduled).

source.title: Source
source.description: Information about the organization or person responsible for issuing the bulletin, including provider details and contact information.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: List of regions (geographical areas) covered by this bulletin. Each region is identified by a unique regionID and may include a name and metadata.

dangerRatings.title: Danger Ratings
dangerRatings.description: Array of danger rating objects, each describing the avalanche danger level for a specific elevation band, aspect, or time period within the bulletin's validity.

avalancheProblems.title: Avalanche Problems
avalancheProblems.description: Array of avalanche problem objects, each detailing a specific avalanche problem type, affected terrain, expected size, stability, and frequency for the bulletin period.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: Optional short text used to emphasize particularly dangerous situations or key messages for the public. Should be concise and attention-grabbing.

weatherForecast.title: Weather Forecast Synopsis
weatherForecast.description:
Weather forecast summary, including a headline (highlight) and detailed comment. May use HTML tags for formatting (e.g.,
,
    ,
  • ).

weatherReview.title: Weather Review Synopsis
weatherReview.description: Review of recent weather conditions relevant to avalanche risk, with a highlight and detailed comment. Supports HTML formatting.

avalancheActivity.title: Avalanche Activity
avalancheActivity.description: Summary of observed avalanche activity, including a highlight and detailed comment. Useful for situational awareness and trend analysis.

snowpackStructure.title: Snowpack Structure
snowpackStructure.description: Detailed description of the current snowpack structure, including weak layers, crusts, and other relevant features. Includes a highlight and comment.

travelAdvisory.title: Travel Advisory
travelAdvisory.description: Travel advisory section providing guidance and recommendations for safe travel in avalanche terrain. Includes a highlight and comment.

tendency.title: Tendency
tendency.description: Detailed description of the expected trend or tendency in avalanche danger after the current bulletin's validity period. May include both structured and free-text elements.

dangerRating.title: Danger Rating
dangerRating.description: Defines an avalanche danger rating for a specific elevation band, aspect, or time period. If a danger rating is constrained by elevation or validTimePeriod, additional ratings should be provided for other cases to ensure full coverage.

dangerRatingValue.title: Danger Rating Value
dangerRatingValue.description: Avalanche danger level as defined by the EAWS danger scale. Allowed values: low, moderate, considerable, high, very_high, no_snow, no_rating.

avalancheProblem.title: Avalanche Problem
avalancheProblem.description: Describes a specific avalanche problem expected during the bulletin period, including type, affected terrain, expected avalanche size, snowpack stability, and frequency. May also include an implied danger rating value. Provides context for risk assessment and mitigation.

avalancheProblemType.title: Avalanche Problem Type
avalancheProblemType.description: Type of avalanche problem expected, as defined by the EAWS. Examples: new_snow, wind_slab, persistent_weak_layers, wet_snow, gliding_snow, cornices, no_distinct_avalanche_problem, favourable_situation.

avalancheSize.title: Expected Avalanche Size
avalancheSize.description: Expected size of potential avalanches, following the EAWS scale. Integer value from 1 (small) to 5 (extremely large).

snowpackStability.title: Expected Snowpack Stability
snowpackStability.description: Expected snowpack stability, using the EAWS four-stage scale: very_poor, poor, fair, good.

frequency.title: Expected Avalanche Frequency
frequency.description: Expected frequency of spots with the lowest snowpack stability, using the EAWS four-stage scale: none, few, some, many.

tendency.title: Avalanche Situation Tendency
tendency.description: Describes the expected trend in avalanche danger (increasing, steady, or decreasing) for a defined time period, supporting risk planning beyond the current bulletin.

metaData.title: Meta Data
metaData.description: Metadata for various uses, such as linking to external files (maps, images, thumbnails), providing additional context, or referencing related resources.

extFile.title: External File
extFile.description: Describes an external file resource, such as a map, image, or document, that is linked to the bulletin or its components. Includes file type, description, and URI.

customData.title: Custom Data
customData.description: Flexible field for adding arbitrary additional information, including AWS-specific custom data types. Allows for extensibility beyond the standard schema.

source.title: Avalanche Bulletin Source
source.description: Information about the source of the bulletin, either as a person (author) or as a provider (organization/AWS). Includes contact and metadata fields.

provider.title: Avalanche Bulletin Provider
provider.description: Details about the organization or provider responsible for issuing the bulletin. Includes name, website, and optional contact person.

person.title: Person
person.description: Information about a person, such as an author or contact, including name, website, and optional metadata.

region.title: Region
region.description: Describes a region (or micro-region) for which the bulletin is valid. The regionID should follow the EAWS schema. It is recommended to maintain region shape files with matching IDs in the EAWS regions repository. Optionally includes a human-readable name and metadata.

aspects.title: Aspects
aspects.description: Defines one or more slope aspects (expositions) relevant to avalanche danger. Aspects are represented as eight 45° segments: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW. Use 'n/a' if not applicable.

elevation.title: Elevation Boundary or Band
elevation.description: Describes an elevation boundary or band relevant to avalanche danger. If only upperBound is set, it refers to elevations below that value; if only lowerBound is set, it refers to elevations above that value. If both are set, it defines an elevation band. Values should be numeric (minimum 100m resolution) or 'treeline'.

validTime.title: Valid Time
validTime.description: Defines a time period with a start and end, both as ISO 8601 timestamps (UTC or with time zone). Used to specify the validity of bulletin elements.

validTimePeriod.title: Valid Time Period
validTimePeriod.description: Specifies a named time period within the bulletin's validity, such as 'all_day', 'earlier', or 'later'. Useful for distinguishing danger ratings or avalanche problems by time of day.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description:
Object containing a highlight (headline) and a comment (detailed text). Supports HTML tags for formatting:
(new line),
    /
  • (lists),

    -

    (headings), (bold).

languageCode.title: Language Code
languageCode.description: Language code for the bulletin, using the two-letter ISO 639-1 standard (e.g., 'en', 'de').
